tagline: Answer drawing questions with traceable visual evidence.
introduction: Help answer questions about construction drawings and BIM using identified sheet regions, explicit units, source revisions and uncertainty. Delegate bounded visual interpretation to NVIDIA when the authorized host exposes the drawing operation; Stoa keeps responsibility for geometry checks, citations and the final answer.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Stoa? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Review supplied project information
capabilities.description: Identify missing context and conflicting statements in supplied construction notes.

capabilities.title: Plan an information handoff
capabilities.description: Organize what the next project participant needs to know.

capabilities.title: Map project data ownership
capabilities.description: Describe a simple information model with version and review status.

capabilities.title: Check a fictional revision handoff
capabilities.description: Check invented document revisions, ownership and acceptance bindings without inspecting BIM files or authorizing site actions.

capabilities.title: Design Stoa challenge support
capabilities.description: Drawing evidence-region verifier. Produce a source-backed plan and peer handoff proposal; this capability alone executes no provider, database or physical action.
inputs: a scoped public or synthetic task and the exact challenge or integration question
outputs: Answer accuracy plus cited-region support against whole-sheet multimodal baseline
source references, dependencies and explicitly unverified actions

capabilities.title: Delegate a source-bound drawing region
capabilities.description: Prepare a bounded drawing task for NVIDIA drawing-observation, verify source and region bindings and return an attributed candidate or abstention. Developer execution requires an approved model connection; production requires the existing Chibi host.
inputs: cleared drawing-region images, image hashes, page bounds, question and source revision
outputs: attributed drawing observations, cited regions, uncertainty and delegation receipt

starterPrompts: Plan a source-backed drawing evidence-region verifier task for this challenge.
Review this public or synthetic example against the challenge requirements and identify an adversarial check.
Prepare a bounded peer-agent handoff with input evidence, expected output, source revision and explicit unknowns.
